The issuer shows reasonable profitability (EBIT/Revenue ≈ 23.6%), and substantial retained earnings and equity that provide some loss-absorbing capacity. However, liquidity is somewhat tight (current ratio 1.18) and leverage is relatively elevated (liabilities of 26.6B vs. equity of 14.3B), which limits credit resilience. Overall, this aligns with a lower-investment-grade profile.

DECISION: BBB-
